<!--
Required R packages (external diagnostics):

  tier       package    role
  --------   ---------  --------------------------------------------------
  core       knitr      knit template; format LaTeX tables
  run_code   r4ss       read SS3 output for maturity, selectivity, index fit
  run_code   FLRebuild  curveSS(); production and reference points from SS3
  run_code   ss3om      readFLSss3(); FLR stock objects from SS3
  run_code   FLCandy    matSel(); maturity vs selectivity ogives
  run_code   sstruth    diagSS, spSsbFromSs3, ssPeDiagnose, plotSpSsb
  run_code   diags      extract CPUE/index series from SS3 diagnostics (.diagUss)
  run_code   mpb        lowess smoothing and scaling for CPUE time-series plots
  run_code   plyr       reshape index data (ddply)
  run_code   reshape2   wide format for correlation plots (cast)
  planned    ggplot2    CPUE time series, survey vs biomass, sel/mat, LBI
  planned    GGally     pairwise scatter plots of index correlations (ggpairs)
  planned    ggcorrplot correlation matrix with hierarchical clustering
  planned    FLCore     FLR indicators and survey standardisation objects
  planned    FLife      cross-correlations between indices (my_ccf)
  planned    mydas      life-history indicators (LBI); my_smooth for ggpairs

Source material:
  - pe-ss3-sma/PE-sma-results.Rmd         (curveSS, readFLSss3)
  - appendices/Rmd/examples/sma_south.Rmd (CPUE series, correlations, clusters, CCF)
  - ss-ll/Rmd/sma_ll.Rmd                   (same CPUE chunks, active eval)
  - ss-ll/Rmd/lbi.R                        (length-based indicators)
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(params$appendix_dir, "R", "appendix-utils.R"))
cfg <- resolve_appendix_params(params)
load_appendix_helpers(cfg)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.path = file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "external", "external-"),
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 200
)

dir.create(file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "external"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)
paths <- scenario_paths(cfg)
paths_ok <- paths[dir.exists(paths)]
do_run <- isTRUE(cfg$run_code) && length(paths_ok) > 0L
if (do_run) {
  require_ok(length(paths_ok) > 0L, "No SS3 scenario directories found under ss_base", cfg)
}
ss3 <- if (do_run) load_assessment_case_study(cfg) else NULL
st_ext <- if (do_run) load_assessment_external(cfg, reference_path(cfg)) else NULL
cv_loo <- if (do_run) load_collected_crossvalidation(cfg) else NULL
if (do_run) {
  require_ok(!is.null(ss3$fls), "SS3 FLR load (ss3$fls)", cfg)
}
```

```{r write-libraries, include=FALSE}
external_libraries <- data.frame(
  package = c(
    "knitr", "r4ss", "sstruth", "FLRebuild", "ss3om", "FLCandy", "diags", "mpb",
    "plyr", "reshape2", "ggplot2", "GGally", "ggcorrplot", "FLCore", "FLife", "mydas"
  ),
  role = c(
    "Knit template; format LaTeX tables",
    "Read SS3 output for maturity, selectivity, and index fit",
    "diagSS, spSsbFromSs3, ssPeDiagnose; external CPUE and SP plots",
    "curveSS(); production and reference points from SS3",
    "readTruth / readFLSss3(); FLR stock objects from SS3",
    "matSel(); maturity vs selectivity ogives",
    "Extract CPUE/index series from SS3 diagnostics (.diagUss)",
    "Lowess smoothing and scaling for CPUE time-series plots",
    "Reshape index data (ddply)",
    "Wide format for correlation plots (cast)",
    "CPUE time series, survey vs biomass, sel/mat, LBI",
    "Pairwise scatter plots of index correlations (planned)",
    "Correlation matrix with hierarchical clustering (planned)",
    "FLR indicators and survey standardisation objects (planned)",
    "Cross-correlations between indices (planned)",
    "Life-history indicators (LBI); my_smooth for ggpairs (planned)"
  ),
  tier = c(
    "core", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code",
    "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code",
    rep("planned", 5L)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write_libraries(cfg, "external", external_libraries)
```

```{r write-evidence, include=FALSE}
external_evidence <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Growth and maturity",
    "Selectivity at age",
    "Survey perception",
    "Age structure",
    "Spatial availability",
    "Fishery behaviour / non-retention"
  ),
  evidence_source = c(
    "Life-history inputs to SS3",
    "Fleet selectivity ogives from SS3",
    "Standardised CPUE / survey indices (external to likelihood if pre-processed)",
    "Length and age composition data",
    "Spatial models / availability (if used outside SS3)",
    "Discard and non-retention regulations"
  ),
  model_quantity = c(
    "Maturity-at-age vs selectivity-at-age",
    "Selectivity ogive",
    "Index fit and scaling",
    "Age composition residuals",
    "Recruitment / availability deviations",
    "Catch-at-age and discard mortality"
  ),
  criterion = c(
    "Fishing should not heavily precede 50 percent maturity on SSB scale",
    "Selectivity peak below maturity implies lagged SSB response",
    "Assessment trend coherent with survey perception",
    "Older-fish / age-structure signals consistent with depletion narrative",
    "No double-counting of spatial signal inside SS3",
    "Removals dominated by juveniles while state is mature female SSB"
  ),
  status = c(
    "Check",
    "Mismatch flagged in case study",
    "Check",
    "Check",
    "Check",
    "Mismatch flagged in case study"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write_content(
  cfg,
  "external/evidence.tex",
  c(
    kable_fragment(
      external_evidence,
      caption = "External evidence register for the shortfin mako SS3 case study.",
      label = "tab:external-evidence"
    ),
    ""
  )
)
```

```{r write-checks, include=FALSE}
checks_lines <- c("% External comparison tables.", "")

if (!is.null(st_ext) && !is.null(st_ext$ss_pe)) {
  pe_tbl <- ss_pe_diagnostics_table(
    cbind(
      scenario = gsub("Scenario-", "Scenario ", basename(reference_path(cfg))),
      as.data.frame(st_ext$ss_pe, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  if (!is.null(pe_tbl)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        pe_tbl,
        caption = "Surplus-production vs SS3 process-error diagnostics (sstruth::ssPeDiagnose).",
        label = "tab:external-sspe"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(cv_loo) && !is.null(cv_loo$results) && NROW(cv_loo$results)) {
  cv_tbl <- cv_loo$results
  num_cols <- vapply(cv_tbl, is.numeric, logical(1))
  cv_tbl[num_cols] <- lapply(cv_tbl[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 4))
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    kable_fragment(
      cv_tbl,
      caption = "Leave-one-out CPUE cross-validation: change in total log-likelihood and terminal status vs reference (run-crossvalidation.R).",
      label = "tab:external-cv-loo"
    ),
    ""
  )
}

if (length(checks_lines) <= 2L) {
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    "% CPUE/index correlations: see appendices/Rmd/examples/sma_south.Rmd",
    "%   chunks: cpue-correlations, cpue-clusters, ccf",
    ""
  )
}

write_content(cfg, "external/checks.tex", checks_lines)
```

```{r write-output, include=FALSE}
output_lines <- c("% External diagnostic figures.", "")

if (!is.null(st_ext) && !is.null(st_ext$diag)) {
  cpue_fig <- save_appendix_figure(
    cfg,
    plot_cpue_ts_external(st_ext$diag),
    strand = "external",
    filename = "cpue-ts.png",
    width = 6,
    height = 10
  )
  if (!is.null(cpue_fig) && file.exists(cpue_fig)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        cpue_fig,
        caption = "Standardised CPUE time series by fleet (sstruth::diagSS; lowess trend when mpb available).",
        label = "fig:external-cpue-ts",
        width = 0.72
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(st_ext) && !is.null(st_ext$sp)) {
  sp_fig <- save_appendix_figure(
    cfg,
    plot_sp_ssb_external(st_ext$sp, cfg = cfg),
    strand = "external",
    filename = "sp-ssb.png",
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )
  if (!is.null(sp_fig) && file.exists(sp_fig)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        sp_fig,
        caption = "Empirical surplus production vs spawning stock biomass (sstruth::spSsbFromSs3).",
        label = "fig:external-sp-ssb",
        width = 0.88
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(ss3) && !is.null(ss3$fls)) {
  selmat_fig <- save_appendix_figure(
    cfg,
    plot_selmat_fls(ss3$fls, labels = scenario_labels(cfg)),
    strand = "external",
    filename = "selmat.png",
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )
  if (!is.null(selmat_fig) && file.exists(selmat_fig)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        selmat_fig,
        caption = "Comparison of selectivity and maturity-at-age in the shortfin mako SS3 scenarios (from readFLSss3).",
        label = "fig:external-selmat",
        width = 0.88
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

selmat <- file.path(cfg$project_dir, "figs", "selmat.png")
if (file.exists(selmat) && !any(grepl("fig:external-selmat", output_lines))) {
  output_lines <- c(
    output_lines,
    figure_fragment(
      cfg,
      selmat,
      caption = "Comparison of selectivity and maturity-at-age in the illustrative shortfin mako SS3 scenarios.",
      label = "fig:external-selmat",
      width = 0.88
    ),
    ""
  )
}

write_content(cfg, "external/output.tex", output_lines)
```
